newsitem.title: USA: Fenway Partners buys Delimex from O.R.A. Corp.
newsitem.headline: Fenway Partners buys Delimex from O.R.A. Corp.

text.p: Private New York investment firm Fenway Partners Inc said Thursday that it had completed its acquistion of frozen ethnic foods producer Delimex from O.R.A. Corp.
Fenway said the acquisition was completed with Delimex senior management, including Chief Executive Pedro Luis Durn and President Oscar Ancira.

Delimex, which has sales approaching $100 million, is headquartered in San Diego, California and supplies frozen Mexican and Asian foods to Price Costco and Sam's outlets. It markets its products under the Delimex and Rice Gourmet brands in more than 4,000 supermarkets in the West and Southwest.
Fenway is the majority shareholder in Van de Kamp's Inc.
